cases.name: Dianna Mae Redmon
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Dianna was an avid quilter. She was a tremendous blessing to her church. She worked with the homeless outreaches and various other community projects. Her smile, laugh and the love that she gave will surely be missed."
cases.narrative: Her daughter Tammy found her body on a sloping hill on the family property near their house on Neef Lane in Shingle Springs. He allegedly hog-tied her, shot her in the head, and threw her over a hill.
